title: Data-driven Precipitation Nowcasting Using Satellite Imagery
migration_inspection: The pinned migrated repository has data and preprocessing resources, not an updated network implementation.
adaptations: Isolated torch-only namespace; no upstream edits or runtime monkeypatches.
Four observed satellite frames with ten channels predict four future satellite frames.
No DEM, historical radar/rain, or future observations are accepted by the forward API.
Return all ten forecast channels instead of the upstream hardcoded first three channels.
Keep the eight executed temporal blocks; omit the registered but never executed ninth block.
Preserve the ResNet/ReLU/BatchNorm generator graph with four downsampling stages and nine residual blocks.
Reduce generator base width from 64 to 30 for full-pipeline parameter matching.
Use linear precipitation readout in the native unbounded project label domain instead of upstream Tanh.
Use calendar day 1..366 and fractional hour [0,24), conditioned on the last observed frame.
Joint rain/satellite MSE 2:1 is a transfer protocol, not a reproduction of original separate GAN training.
